slug: 2026-07-09 NIMC Enrols 136 Million Nigerians as Coker-Odusote Pushes Stronger Inter-Ministerial Partnership

facts.fact: The Guardian reports that the newly enacted NIMC Act 2026, an Act of the National Assembly, replaces the repealed 2007 Act and is being implemented by NIMC; the document gives no enactment date, so its publication date is used.

The NIMC Director-General says the NIMC Act 2026 carries a 'One Identity, One Number' policy that eliminates duplication, so each person holds a single National Identification Number (NIN) in the national identity database.
